CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Self-hosted apps by jakeshake.**
**Pinebridge**: TradingView alerts to MetaTrader 5, on your own Unraid server. No signal-relay subscription and no VPS bill, and your broker login stays on your own server. Two containers: **pinebridge-mt5** (a Windows 11 VM that installs MT5 and the Pinebridge Expert Advisor) and **pinebridge-bridge** (receives TradingView webhooks and serves a LAN-only dashboard). Pinebridge places real trades automatically: read the [risk notice](https://github.com/jakeshake/pinebridge/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md) and test on a demo account first. [Setup guide](https://github.com/jakeshake/pinebridge/blob/main/docs/unraid-install.md)
**Wordly**: daily word games for your family or friends, with shared leaderboards. Includes Wordly (5 or 6-letter guessing), Spelly Bee, Boxy Letters and Connecty, plus a dozen themes. One small container with no database.
CommunityApplications.DonateText: If these apps save you time or money, consider buying me a coffee.
